definitions.gloss: checking one's answers (against the correct ones)
definitions.explanation: Comparing one's answers to a test, quiz or exercise with the correct answers to see which are right. Also used figuratively for finding out whether a guess or prediction was right. Takes する.

examples.japanese: {答|こた}え{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{答|こた}え{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{答|こた}え{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}んだ→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧。
examples.english: After the exam I compared answers with my friends and felt down.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧ (answer) and {合|あ}わせ (matching). Common in school, where pupils check their own work or each other's; marking by a teacher is ⟦{採点|さいてん}→採点：04160_saiten⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {答|こた}え{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to check the answers
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{答|こた}え{合|あ}わせ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to check one's own answers
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{答|こた}え{合|あ}わせ: seeing whether a prediction came true

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{採点|さいてん}→採点：04160_saiten⟧: marking, grading — giving scores
- ⟦{正解|せいかい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧: the correct answer
